units.CD9107-dimbelenge: Dimbelenge territory (Kasaï-Central) comprises the Katende, Muetshi, Bena Tshiadi and Lubunga secteurs with Dimbelenge town as chief town. It was part of the 2016-2017 Kamuina Nsapu insurgency theatre, which FARDC operations crushed; most militiamen surrendered by 2019. No armed group is known to hold territory as of 2026: Dimbelenge town is policed by the PNC with FARDC and ANR present, and villages fall under PNC posts and customary chiefs. Assessment relies on background knowledge because live web research was unavailable in this run, so confidence is limited.
